alyssa: Heads up — perf regression on qwen-220B long-context sweep after the kernel-selector change. 2-3x latency at 8k+ seq. Anyone else seeing this?

perf-bot: nightly-run summary for qwen-220b longctx:
```
baseline: 15 ms/token @ batch=4 seq=2048
new:      32 ms/token @ batch=4 seq=8192
trace_id: perf-run-2026-03-05-1798754321
```

mike: I can repro. Appears only when `rope_scale=1.08` and the selector picks `matmul_fused_v3` instead of `attention_split_kv`. Suspect KV cache evict thrash. :thinking:

sabrina: nvprof trace shows spikes around KV read path — heavy L2 misses and extra memcpy calls at step ~1200.
```
== nvprof snippet ==
Memcpy H2D size=384MB time=1.2ms
L2_MISS  count=1.4M
kern: matmul_fused_v3  time=3.8ms  memcopy+sync
```

kai: Is it unique to Qwen? I ran mixtral-7b with same config and no regression. Qwen's larger head/kv dim seems to trigger the fused kernel fallback.

joel: FYI kernel-selector change from PR #6423 prefers fused matmul for width>1280. That would explain why qwen picked a different implementation.

alyssa: Can we run a micro-batch sweep? batch sizes 1..8 at seq len 4096 and 8192 on heavy runners. I'll patch selector to force `attention_split_kv` for qwen and run.

infra-bot: jenkins: started job runtime-perf/qwen-longctx-sweep/1798754321

mike: Patch applied locally — forcing `attention_split_kv` yields 18 ms/token at 8k vs 32ms before. Throughput mostly restored. Need to quantify memory tradeoffs.

sabrina: Root cause: fused kernel ends up doing a prologue memcpy of the whole KV per token due to its blocking layout. split-kv reads incremental slices only, so much less bandwidth.

kai: Recommendation: add heuristic: if `kv_dim_ratio>1.0` and `seq_len>4096` prefer `split-kv`. Also expose per-model `force_split_kv` flag in model-config.

joel: Also adjust batching heuristic: avoid mixing long-context requests with short ones. Suggest `batching.policy.context_homogeneous = true` for qwen pools.

alyssa: I'll open a follow-up PR with tests + perf artifacts and add `kernel_selector.reason` trace logs to canary runs.

perf-bot: job finished: runtime-perf/qwen-longctx-sweep/1798754321
Results (forced split-kv): batch1: 22 ms/token, batch4: 19 ms/token, batch8: 20 ms/token @ seq=8192
Artifacts: s3://perf/qwen/1798754321

mike: Nice. Plan: ship heuristic + per-model flag, roll canary to 10% dedicated nodes. If stable, roll to prod. :thumbsup:

alyssa: Thanks all — will post a short RFC in eng-runtime with numbers and config diff.
